options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: Orbital Hangar Station
reply.subtitle: Experience zero-gravity retail in an immersive lunar docking bay
reply.line: Step into a weightless environment where precision-engineered eyewear floats within a sterile, futuristic hangar.
reply.synopsis: You enter through a shimmering steel cable curtain, passing between magnetic aluminium pylons that define the threshold of your journey. As you move into the mineral-white airlock, you encounter a levitating mirror-aluminium dock where products appear suspended in defiance of gravity. You circle this central void, eventually turning toward glass observation bays that invite you to inspect every detail of the collection. Finally, you conclude your mission at the brushed aluminium flight manifest terminal located against the back wall.
reply.quote: In the absence of gravity, the product becomes the singular point of focus in a vast, silent expanse.

why.meaning: The narrow gap between the aluminium pylons forces you to slow your pace, signaling the transition into a controlled orbital space.
Maintaining a respectful distance from the levitating dock ensures the illusion of weightlessness remains intact as you orbit the hero display.
Positioning the glass bays away from the center encourages you to step out of the flow to engage in a quiet, intimate product assessment.
The terminal provides a definitive physical anchor point to finalize your experience before exiting the hangar.

why.d: Two magnetic docking pylons objects stand 1.0-3.0 m inside the door with the atmospheric pressure curtain between them; the route slips through a 1.9 m gap. The narrow gap between the aluminium pylons forces you to slow your pace, signaling the transition into a controlled orbital space.

The levitating magnetic dock stands alone in a 8 x 7 m zero gravity airlock; the route circles it and never comes closer than 3.3 m. Maintaining a respectful distance from the levitating dock ensures the illusion of weightlessness remains intact as you orbit the hero display.

Four eyewear observation bays stations sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the levitating magnetic dock to reach them. Positioning the glass bays away from the center encourages you to step out of the flow to engage in a quiet, intimate product assessment.
The flight manifest terminal closes the loop at the back wall. The terminal provides a definitive physical anchor point to finalize your experience before exiting the hangar.
